turacin.definition:
n. A red or crimson pigment obtained from certain feathers of
   several species of turacou; whence the name. It contains nearly six per
   cent of copper.

turaco.definition: n large brightly crested bird of Africa
turaco.translation: n. [鸟]蕉鹃(产于非洲热带森林)

turacou.definition: n large brightly crested bird of Africa
turacou.translation: n. [鸟]蕉鹃(产于非洲热带森林)

turandot.translation: n. 图兰朵（意大利作曲家普契尼的代表作）

turanian.definition:
a. Of, pertaining to, or designating, an extensive family of
   languages of simple structure and low grade (called also Altaic,
   Ural-Altaic, and Scythian), spoken in the northern parts of Europe and
   Asia and Central Asia; of pertaining to, or designating, the people who
   speak these languages.
n. One of the Turanians.

turanians.definition:
n. pl. An extensive division of mankind including the
   Mongols and allied races of Asia, together with the Malays and
   Polynesians.
n. pl. A group of races or tribes inhabiting Asia and
   closely related to the Mongols.
turanians.translation:
n. 突雷尼语族；突雷尼人
a. 突雷尼人的；突雷尼语族的

turanose.translation:
[化] 土冉糖; 松二糖
[医] 松二糖, 土冉糖
